text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WAAAAAAAAAAAH!)

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Seeking breaks away! Seeking takes the 
lead! No one can touch her, not even the 
hero can reach her now!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
The winner is Seeking the Pearl! 
Undeniably on the path of a legendary 
Umamusume! Undeniably!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Bravoooo!!!! Yes, this! This, this, this 
is itttt!!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
The world is made for me! I am made for 
the world!! Pearl, Pearler, Pearl-est!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (UOOOOOOOOH!!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Thunderous applause erupts. Today truly 
turned out to be a day for Seeking the 
Pearl.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
—I will make it resonate. The very same 
cheers as today, without fail, in Europe.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"There's nothing missing. Ah, what a 
glamorous life...!"

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
With this, you're the best miler in the 
Classic class. Yes, you can do it if you 
try, everyone.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With the excitement yet to fade, we basked 
in the afterglow of glory and discussed 
what lies ahead.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Hear me, world!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Is that so? Do it! And here I thought you 
could do it if you tried.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Challenging a European G1 at this stage 
really was rushing things far too much...
choice_data_list:
For now is still the time to build up the 
strength you'll need.

For now is still the time to build up the 
strength you'll need.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
The power that's a must-have... What is 
it? And where should I go to obtain it?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As a Trainer, my answer was already clear. 
It might be an unexpected suggestion, 
but...
choice_data_list: —Why don't we aim for the Shuka Sho?
—Why don't we aim for the Shuka Sho?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
The Shuka Sho? The final leg of the Triple 
Tiara... 2000m?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Weren't we supposed to have decided that 
sticking to the mile was best, though...?
choice_data_list:
Still, we really do need to build up your 
stamina.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Building up stamina? Why...?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Ah! European turf...!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As expected of Seeking the Pearl. Her mind 
was exceptionally quick.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
“Yes, European mile races demand more 
stamina than just what a mile requires.”

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Because the grass is so thick, unless you 
have some stamina to spare, you won't be 
able to hold on at the very end.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"To do that, I needed enough stamina to 
finish a domestic 2000m race. At the same 
time—"

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Hey, maybe at 2,000 meters, there's a 
puncher's chance to win?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"And if you go to the Shuka Sho, you might 
even get to reunite with the Pearl 
Family♪"

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Yes, it's Dober. Mejiro Dober♪

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Settling things with Dober on the Triple 
Tiara route before flying overseas might 
be a good plan too.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Dober will certainly show up for 
the Shuka Sho. Far more powered up than 
back in the Junior Class.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And if we are truly aiming to beat her, I 
want her to run a distance close to 2000m 
somewhere. Preferably right before the 
main event.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
So, are we heading straight to the Shuka 
Sho, Trainer?
choice_data_list: No, let's run in the Rose Stakes first.
No, let's run in the Rose Stakes first.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"The Rose Stakes"... An 1800m GII. Many 
Umamusume run there before the Shuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Very well. The Rose, the Shuka, and then 
next year, the world! With this, my path 
from autumn onward is set!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Ohohoho!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Everything is going smoothly. Not a single 
shadow looms. And then—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The blueprint for Seeking the Pearl's 
future— The complete picture of her 
Classic year had finally taken clear shape 
here.
